attributes.board_name: Montana Board of Pharmacy (Department of Labor & Industry)

rules.alternatives: Licensure requires certification by PTCB, ExCPT or another Board-approved certifying entity; keeping that certification follows the certifier's own CE rules.
rules.notes: License renews (renewal period May 2 - June 30, late until Aug 14; fee $30) without a state CE requirement: the Board's technician license page lists no continuing education, only national certification (PTCB/ExCPT), while its pharmacist page lists the CEU requirement. Provisional certified technician licenses (formerly technician-in-training) are valid 12 months.
